fields.desc: S0/S1 error occurred. When S0/S1 error occurs, the slave will recover automatically after 60us as if an HDR-exit pattern is executed on the bus. Flag will persist for notification purpose. This flag is clear-on-read type. It is cleared automatically once read.
fields.name: i3c_err_3

enum_values.desc: SPI and I2C Available (Autoconfig). Interface selection is automatically configured. Default is I2C mode. During Power-on CSB pin should be tied to VDDIO to pull it high at power-on. If CSB goes low during, I2C interface will be disabled until the next power-on-reset.
enum_values.name: Autoconfig

fields.desc: Pad drive strength for serial IO pins SDX, SDO (MSB should be set in I2C mode only). Note: these register fields should be read-back only after waiting at least 1 us after they have been written.
fields.name: pad_if_drv

fields.desc: CSB pullup selection (valid in I2C mode only)
fields.name: i2c_csb_pup_en

fields.desc: Pad drive strength for INT (MSB should be set in INT open drain config only). Note: these register fields should be read-back only after waiting at least 1 us after they have been written
fields.name: pad_int_drv

registers.desc: INT source selection (0x00: Disable INT, except the POR and Software_reset completion)
registers.name: INT_SOURCE

enum_values.desc: Set the FIFO threshold to 31 frames
enum_values.name: FIFO_th_31_frames

fields.desc: If asserted, crack check has been successfully executed without detecting a crack. Note: this bit is cleared with deasserting ASIC_SELFTEST_CTRL.st_crack_check
fields.name: st_crack_pass

fields.desc: If asserted, indicates that an error has been corrected by ECC during last boot-loading. Note: This bit is cleared upon a new NVM user command. Additionally, in deep standby (Normal and Forced) the NVM is downloaded at beginning of each measurement. It is valid after DRY until the next measurement starts.
fields.name: status_boot_err_corrected

fields.desc: If asserted, indicates a boot command error, due to at least one of the following reasons: - nvm_usr_read / nvm_usr_prog command submitted when CFG.STATE.nvm_rdy = 0 (FCU is not in STANDBY mode). Boot command not executed -> Boot.STATUS.* and CFG.status.nvm_err not updated. - nvm_usr_prog command submitted when CFG.MISC.nvm_prog_en = 0. Boot command executed -> Boot.STATUS.* and CFG.status.nvm_err updated. - nvm_usr_prog command submitted with CFG.NVM_ADDR.nvm_row_addr outside valid range (6'h08, 6'h09, 6'h1E-'h622). Boot command executed -> Boot.STATUS.* and CFG.status.nvm_err updated. This bit is cleared upon a new NVM command
fields.name: status_nvm_cmd_err

fields.desc: If asserted, indicates an NVM error, due to at least one of the following reasons: - PMU power transition fail on NVM power request - NVM timeout errors in P/E - NVM Charge Pump voltage fail in PROGRAM/ERASE - During last boot/load command, ECC has detected 2+ errors. This bit is cleared/updated upon a new NVM command, if Boot command is executed.
fields.name: status_nvm_err

fields.desc: If asserted, device is ready for NVM operations
fields.name: status_nvm_rdy

fields.desc: If asserted, the digital core domain is accessible
fields.name: status_core_rdy

fields.desc: If set, enables NVM programming (Note: this field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: nvm_prog_en

fields.desc: NVM (row) address (Note: this field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: nvm_row_address

fields.desc: NVM Data LSB, bits 7:0. Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing conversion and should be read-back only after an idle time of at least 1 us.
fields.name: nvm_data_lsb

fields.desc: NVM Data MSB, bits 15:8. Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing conversion and should be read-back only after an idle time of at least 1 us.
fields.name: nvm_data_msb

fields.desc: OOR IIR selection (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: oor_sel_iir_p

fields.desc: FIFO IIR selection pressure data (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: fifo_sel_iir_p

fields.desc: Shadow Registers IIR selection pressure data (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: shdw_sel_iir_p

fields.desc: FIFO IIR selection temperature data (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: fifo_sel_iir_t

fields.desc: Temperature Data Registers IIR selection temperature data (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: shdw_sel_iir_t

fields.desc: If set, an IIR filter flush is executed in FORCED mode (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: iir_flush_forced_en

enum_values.desc: Press.: no compensation, Temp.: no compensation
enum_values.name: No_comp

fields.desc: Pressure IIR LPF band filter selection. The filter coefficient (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: set_iir_p

fields.desc: Temperature IIR LPF band filter selection. The filter coefficient (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: set_iir_t

fields.desc: OOR count limit (Note: This field cannot be written during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: cnt_lim

fields.desc: If set, enables sensor pressure measurements. Otherwise temperature only measurements is done.
fields.name: press_en

fields.desc: OSR_T selection. Note: the configured ODR might be invalid in combination with OSR configuration. This is observable with the ODR_CONFIG.flag odr_is_valid. If configured ODR/OSR settings are invalid, default OSR settings will be used. The effective OSR settings for P/T can be read from osr_t_eff and osr_p_eff.
fields.name: osr_t

fields.desc: If asserted, disables the deep standby (Note: This field cannot be changed during an ongoing P/T conversion.)
fields.name: deep_dis

fields.desc: ODR Selection. Note: the configured ODR might be invalid in combination with OSR configuration. This is observable with the flag odr_is_valid. If configured ODR/OSR settings are invalid, default OSR settings will be used. The effective OSR settings for P/T can be read from osr_t_eff and osr_p_eff.
fields.name: odr

fields.desc: Power mode configuration. The user can request a dedicated power mode by writing this field. A read returns the actual mode the device is in. Note: This bit is cleared again upon transition from FORCED to STANDBY mode.

enum_values.desc: Normal mode: measurement in configured ODR grid
enum_values.name: Normal

enum_values.desc: Non-Stop mode: repetitive measurements without further duty-cycling
enum_values.name: Non_Stop

fields.name: pwr_mode

fields.desc: If asserted, the ODR parametrization is valid (This is checked on every change in ODR and OSR configuration registers.)
fields.name: odr_is_valid

fields.desc: OSR_P effective selection. Effectively selected OSR for pressure. Please refer to OSR_CONFIG for encodings.
fields.name: osr_p_eff

fields.desc: OSR_T effective selection. Effectively selected OSR for temperature. Please refer to OSR_CONFIG for encodings.
fields.name: osr_t_eff

registers.desc: Command Register (Register will always read as 0x00)

fields.desc: Available commands (Note: Register will always read as 0x00): no other values must be written to this register

enum_values.desc: First CMD in the sequence 0x5D, 0xA0/0xA5 which enables the write/read of the NVM. If another CMD is sent within the sequence, the sequence for enabling the NVM prog mode is reset.
enum_values.name: nvm_seq_first

enum_values.desc: Last CMD in the sequence 0x73, 0xB4, 0x69, which enables the extended mode and makes the debug and test pages in the register map visible. If another CMD is sent within the sequence, the sequence for enabling the extended page mode is reset. The pages are changed using the register EXT_MODE. Disabling the extended mode is done by resetting the paging enable bit in the paging register.
enum_values.name: ext_mode_first

enum_values.desc: Last CMD in the sequence 0x5D, 0xA0 which enables the write of the NVM. If another CMD is sent within the sequence, the sequence for triggering the NVM programming is reset.
enum_values.name: nvm_write_en

enum_values.desc: Last CMD in the sequence 0x5D, 0xA5 which enables the read of the NVM. If another CMD is sent within the sequence, the sequence for triggering the NVM read is reset.
enum_values.name: nvm_read_en

enum_values.desc: Triggers a reset, all user configuration settings are overwritten with their default state. If this register is set using I2C, an ACK will NOT be transmitted to the host.
enum_values.name: soft_reset
